correctness.rationale: For rotations only, a cyclic word determines one Euler circuit on the labelled k-bit arcs, hence one successor permutation with one full cycle. At each (k−1)-bit suffix v, a local bit selects between the two bijections from 0v,1v to v0,v1; two cycles get two common (k+1)-factors or none at v according to equality of this bit. The constant k-bit states cannot succeed themselves, so the two constant suffix bits are forced and contribute four common factors for k≥2. Single-cycle permutations have the same sign, while each changed bit transposes two successor values. Therefore the number of differing bits is even and I=2^k−2d_H is divisible by four, including the identical-cycle case. Separate reproduction in /workspace/branches/55e54dc1-2e5b-48f1-a1e9-1eeb84cbb9d6/reproduce_order5.py exhausted the 16384 admissible masks, selected exactly 2048 by single-orbit testing, and counted all 2096128 unordered distinct pairs by both mask distance and literal circular factors. Counts at overlaps 4,8,12,16,20,24,28 are respectively 368,27104,254800,710976,758800,305376,38704. The two stated witness words each have 32 distinct circular five-factors, and their six-factor intersection is exactly {000001,011111,100000,111110}, with masks 0x80af and 0xff51. The complement of the 14 free bits is the only possible overlap-four partner; it is valid for 736 cycles. The frozen verifier was inspected, not executed. The computation proves only the order-five census; the universal assertion is analytic and does not claim overlap four is attainable for every order.

evidence: Alhakim gives connectivity for the regular de Bruijn cycles and defines a cross-join as two successor interchanges at conjugate pairs; the binary result also predates that generalization. Chen et al. formulate orthogonality as no repeated (k+1)-word between collection members, via compatible Euler circuits. Lin et al. could not be inspected in full.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Orthogonality as a zero-overlap condition is not the finite nonzero-overlap spectrum. In contrast, the general connectivity theorem applies to the same binary cycles at every order and directly enforces the parity obstruction through the local switch rule.

evidence: In binary, a conjugate pair consists of 0v and 1v, so switching its successors flips one suffix bit. Connectivity under double switches forces even Hamming distance between any two valid masks. A circuit must enter and leave each constant state via the non-loop transition, giving four forced factors. The indexed order-five census explicitly supplies the distribution of half that Hamming distance.

value.rationale: Six-factor overlap is a natural finite statistic, but the exact order-five fact and best-partner census are an affine relabeling of an available complete table. The general bound and congruence extract a local consequence of the established switch structure without adding a new extremal range or classification.
